changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO direction (id, code, nom, region_id, created_by, created_date) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), d.code, d.nom, r.id, 'system', now() FROM (VALUES ('516', 'CENTRE MEDICAL TAHOUA'), ('517', 'DIRECTION REGIONALE TAHOUA') ) AS d(code, nom) JOIN region r ON upper(trim(r.nom)) = 'TAHOUA' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
